hints.title: Adjacent Value Pairing Loss Minimization
hints.text: In each pair, the larger value is sacrificed while the smaller value contributes to the sum. Minimizing the sacrifice requires pairing close values together.

hints.title: Sorted Even Index Invariant
hints.text: Sorting the array places optimal pairs adjacent to each other, so the minimum of each pair (nums[2i], nums[2i + 1]) is simply nums[2i].

hints.title: Sorted Stride Summation Procedure
hints.text: Sort the array in ascending order. Sum all elements located at even indices 0, 2, 4, up to length minus two. Return the sum.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairings takes factorial time and exceeds execution bounds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(N log N) time, followed by a linear scan taking O(1) auxiliary space beyond the sorting buffer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prove why sorting minimizes wasted value difference and implement the stride-2 summation.
